figurative_meaning_bn: ন্যায্য কথা বলার বা উচিতকাজ করার সাহস
figurative_meaning_en: Courage to speak justly or do the right thing
similar_in_english: Guts to stand up for what's right
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সৎসাহস দেখে সকলে প্রশংসা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: His moral courage earned everyone's praise.
Moral courage is needed at this time.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots emphasizing truth and bravery in Bengali linguistic tradition
